summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 financial results, with revenues of $170.2M, profit of $88.3M, EPS of $2.31, and declared a $2.00 per share dividend. The filing is a routine earnings release with no mention of any special-situation M&A, activism, restructuring, or strategic review. It does not trigger classification as a special situation.
